check.pieces_mismatch.why: Customs and the airline count pieces. A different count causes holds and short-shipment claims.
check.pieces_mismatch.fix: Count the cargo or ask the shipper which document is right, then correct the wrong one.
check.weight_mismatch.message: Gross weight differs by {diff} kg: {a} kg on {docA}, {b} kg on {docB}.
check.weight_mismatch.why: Customs compares weights across documents. A gap above tolerance can trigger a query or re-weighing charges.
check.weight_mismatch.fix: Check the weight slip. Correct the document that is wrong, or record why the difference is acceptable.
check.shipper_mismatch.why: A party name that does not match can stop clearance or release.
check.shipper_mismatch.fix: Use the exact legal name on all documents. If this is a known abbreviation, accept it once and Ophanim will remember.
check.consignee_mismatch.why: The consignee on the AWB or B/L must match the importer of record, or the cargo cannot be released.
check.consignee_mismatch.fix: Confirm the consignee with the client and amend the house document before arrival.
check.hs_code_plausibility.message: HS code {code} looks unusual for "{description}" (expected chapter {expected}).
check.hs_code_plausibility.why: A wrong HS code changes duty and can lead to a customs query or penalty.
check.hs_code_plausibility.fix: Check the HS code with the client or broker. This is a soft warning; accept it if the code is right.
check.invoice_lines_total.message: Invoice lines add up to {sum} but the total says {total}.
check.invoice_lines_total.why: Customs value is taken from the invoice. Arithmetic errors cause valuation queries.
check.invoice_lines_total.fix: Ask the shipper for a corrected invoice.
check.currency_inconsistent.message: More than one currency on the documents: {currencies}.
check.currency_inconsistent.why: Mixed currencies make the declared value unclear.
check.currency_inconsistent.fix: Confirm the invoice currency and correct the other documents.
check.vat_sensible.message: VAT is {vat} on {subtotal} ({rate}%). Expected 5% or zero-rated.
check.vat_sensible.why: UAE VAT is 5% or zero-rated. A wrong amount is a tax error on your invoice.
check.vat_sensible.fix: Recalculate VAT or mark the supply as zero-rated with the reason.
check.chargeable_weight.message: Chargeable weight {stated} kg is below the computed {computed} kg (gross {gross} kg, volume {volume} m³).
check.chargeable_weight.why: Air freight is charged on the higher of gross and volumetric weight (1 m³ = 166.67 kg). Under-charging loses money; the airline will re-bill.
check.chargeable_weight.fix: Use the higher figure on the house AWB and the client invoice.
check.dates_order.message: Dates out of order: {first} ({firstDate}) is after {second} ({secondDate}).
check.dates_order.why: Impossible date sequences suggest a typing or reading error.
check.dates_order.fix: Check both dates against the original paper.
check.date_impossible.why: A date years away usually means a misread day/month or year.
check.date_impossible.fix: Check the date on the paper and correct it.
check.container_check_digit.message: Container number {value} fails its check digit. {detail}
check.container_check_digit.why: A wrong container number means the box cannot be tracked or released.
check.container_check_digit.fix: Read the number again from the paper or the box itself.
check.awb_check_digit.why: A wrong AWB number means the airline and terminal cannot find the cargo.
check.awb_check_digit.fix: Read the number again from the AWB and correct it.
check.missing_document.why: This route requires it before departure. Without it the cargo can be held at destination.
check.missing_document.fix: Request it from the shipper now and photograph it into this job.
check.incoterm_invalid.why: The Incoterm decides who pays freight, duty and insurance.
check.incoterm_invalid.fix: Use one of EXW, FCA, CPT, CIP, DAP, DPU, DDP, FAS, FOB, CFR, CIF.
check.volume_dimensions.message: Volume {stated} m³ does not match the dimensions ({computed} m³).
check.volume_dimensions.why: Volume drives chargeable weight and space booking.
check.volume_dimensions.fix: Re-measure or correct the dimensions or volume.
check.short_landed.message: Short-landed: {pieces} of {expected} pieces at {handoff}. {missing} likely on the next flight.
check.short_landed.why: Missing pieces must be traced now, before the client collects or the airline closes the file.
check.short_landed.fix: Ask the airline/terminal for the short-landed piece status and next flight.
check.piece_increase.message: Piece count went up: {before} at {from}, {after} at {to}.
check.piece_increase.why: Extra pieces can mean another shipment's cargo was mixed in.
check.piece_increase.fix: Recount and check the labels against this job's AWB.
check.chain_weight_difference.message: Weight changed from {before} kg ({from}) to {after} kg ({to}).
check.chain_weight_difference.why: A weight change between handoffs can mean damage, loss or re-weighing charges.
check.chain_weight_difference.fix: Get the weight slip and record the reason.
check.weather_fog.message: Fog risk at {station} on your arrival morning ({window}). {source}
check.weather_fog.why: Fog causes diversions and holding, delaying unloading and terminal receipt.
check.weather_fog.fix: Warn the client the arrival may slip; keep the delivery slot flexible.
check.weather_wind.why: Strong crosswinds can delay landings and ramp operations.
check.weather_wind.fix: Check the flight status close to arrival.
check.weather_dust.why: Dust reduces visibility and slows ground handling and trucking.
check.weather_dust.fix: Allow extra time for unloading and delivery.
check.weather_visibility.why: Low visibility can delay arrivals and ground handling.
check.city_pulse.why: Truck curfews and road rules can stop delivery during these hours.
check.city_pulse.fix: Move the delivery slot outside the restricted hours.
check.invoice_vs_quote.message: Invoice total {total} is {pct}% above the quote ({quote}).
check.invoice_vs_quote.why: Clients dispute invoices well above the quote. This is the top reason for late payment.
check.invoice_vs_quote.fix: Attach the reason (re-weigh, storage, extra service) or correct the charges.
check.invoice_chargeable_changed.message: Chargeable weight on the invoice ({invoice} kg) differs from the job file ({job} kg).
check.invoice_chargeable_changed.why: The carrier bills on the final chargeable weight.
check.invoice_chargeable_changed.fix: Use the job file's checked chargeable weight.
check.invoice_missing_storage.message: Storage was charged to you ({amount}) but is not on the client invoice.
check.invoice_missing_storage.why: Unbilled pass-through costs reduce your margin.
check.invoice_missing_storage.fix: Add the storage line if the contract allows it.
check.invoice_wrong_client.message: Invoice is addressed to {invoice} but the job client is {job}.
check.invoice_wrong_client.why: An invoice to the wrong party will not be paid.
check.invoice_wrong_client.fix: Change the bill-to party to the job client.
lesson.weight_mismatch: Before sending, compare gross weight on invoice, packing list and AWB. They must agree within tolerance.
lesson.pieces_mismatch: Count pieces on every document. One wrong digit holds the whole shipment.
lesson.consignee_mismatch: The consignee must be written exactly the same on every paper.
lesson.chargeable_weight: Air chargeable weight = the higher of gross weight and volume × 166.67.
lesson.awb_check_digit: The last digit of an AWB = first 7 serial digits divided by 7, the remainder.
lesson.container_check_digit: Container numbers have a check digit. If it fails, read the number again.
lesson.invoice_lines_total: Add the invoice lines yourself before accepting the total.
lesson.missing_document: Check the route's document list before the cargo leaves, not after it lands.
